title: Understanding the Effect of Adding a Feature
text: When you add a new feature to a model, especially one that is a transformation of an existing feature, it can affect the model's complexity. How might this change impact the model's ability to generalize to new data?

title: Bias-Variance Tradeoff
text: Adding a new feature can increase the model's flexibility, potentially reducing bias but increasing variance. How does this tradeoff affect the MSE on held-out test data?

title: Analyzing MSE on Test Data
text: Consider how adding a feature affects the model's complexity and its ability to fit the training data versus new data. What are the possible effects on the MSE on held-out test data?
